focus_areas: Realism of the brittle/candy shard texture (porosity vs. plastic smoothness)

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'brittle' toppings. AI often struggles with the complex, porous internal structure of honeycomb or the sharp, irregular fractures of hard candy. If the expert notes these look too smooth or uniformly translucent, flag it as a texture anomaly. Also, verify the glass refraction; AI glasses often fail to distort the background correctly or have inconsistent wall thickness.
